Claude voice mode: 4 steps to talk to Claude AI hands-free, from the sound wave icon to your saved transcript.

Claude voice mode: 4 steps to talk, not type. It works on the free plan.

1. Tap - Tap the sound wave icon beside the microphone.
2. Talk - Speak naturally and ask Claude to brainstorm with you.
3. Connect - With Gmail or Calendar connected, ask it to check them.
4. Read - The transcript is saved in your chat history. Read it later.

Needs: All plans

Official docs: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11101966-use-voice-mode
